entities.name: Nnr-like protein
observations: A 505-aa sequence has 35.0–36.4% identity and 94.5–99.8% coverage to reviewed bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes; function is homology-supported, not experimentally established for this query.
Sequence-derived estimates: 53,939 Da, pI 5.862, GRAVY 0.085, instability index 35.721.
Pfam matches: YjeF_N (PF03853) residues 27–182 and Carb_kinase (PF01256) residues 238–480.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX repair
observations: Homolog annotations support epimerization of (6R)- to (6S)-NADHX/NADPHX and ADP-dependent dehydration of the (6S) forms to NADH/NADPH, AMP, and phosphate; EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136.

entities.name: Potassium cofactor
observations: Reviewed homolog annotations report one K+ ion bound per subunit; applicability to this query is inferred from homology.
